notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch only (curl with browser UA) - no block encountered, robots.txt (User-agent: * / Disallow: /wishlist,/checkout/,/account/) does not restrict category pages. TREE: built from union of /sg/sitemap.xml (1826 URLs) + each candidate category page's own rendered nav/filter panel (confirmed via a small number of Playwright loads where curl's static HTML lacked nav links). Site is a Next.js app whose category listing pages embed a server-rendered Algolia search response (fields nbHits/nbPages/hitsPerPage/facets/categoryContext) directly in the initial HTML - this gave an exact, site-computed product count for every category without needing to paginate through the UI, except where noted. QTY: read directly from the embedded nbHits field for each page (cross-checked against the rendered product-card count and, for /accessories/poufs-cushions-throws, an exact manual count of listed product names = 24, matching nbHits). Confirmed each page's categoryContext/H1 matches the intended node (guards against the 'bad slug silently serves parent/site-wide total' failure mode described in the brief) - this caught /sg/accessories/rugs/large-rugs, which is a dead/bad slug that silently serves an unfiltered site-wide Algolia fallback (nbHits=1216, includes mattresses) rather than a real large-rugs subcategory; it was discarded entirely (not recorded), and Rugs (27) stands alone with no valid subcategory. Also caught /sg/accessories/cushions and /sg/accessories/throws, both true 404s (old slugs) superseded by /sg/accessories/poufs-cushions-throws (site's real Cushions category, categoryContext=['Accessories','Cushions'], nbHits=24; no throw/blanket products currently listed there). EXCLUDED: entire /sg/storage/* nav section (all-storage, bar-cabinets, shelves-bookcases, sideboards-cabinets, tv-consoles, wooden-tv-units, small/long-tv-units) - manually inspected (nbHits=75 on all-storage, product slugs are sideboards/TV consoles/cabinets/bookcases/a bar cart) and every item is Storage Furniture (storage.md Sec21 'Potential Furniture' list: sideboards, cabinets, bookcases, TV/console units) with zero standalone storage boxes/baskets/bins/organizers anywhere on the site (grepped full sitemap for basket/bin/storage-box/organiz - no matches) - so storage_rows is empty for this company; this is a furniture retailer with a furniture-type 'Storage' collection, not a home-organization retailer. Also excluded as non-textile/non-storage: /sg/accessories/all-accessories, /sg/accessories/lighting, /sg/accessories/mirrors*, /sg/accessories/tableware (Lighting/Wall Decor/Kitchen&Dining boundaries, out of scope), /sg/beds/beds,bedside-tables,dressers,storage-beds (Furniture), /sg/accessories/sofa-accessories item 'Sofa Armrest Table' (furniture, not textile), /sg/outdoor/outdoor-accessories item 'Sorrento Outdoor Bar Cart' (furniture, not textile - identified by paginating all 4 result pages of that category via ?p=1..4 and enumerating all 76 product slugs, since page 1 of the SSR payload alone only exposes 24 of 76). Two accessory categories (Sofa Accessories, Outdoor Accessories) are mixed nodes where the site's own displayed total includes exactly one non-textile item alongside otherwise-textile sofa/furniture covers and headrests; the site's own exact count was kept as qty per the no-estimate rule, flagged for review rather than manually recalculated. Bedding (/sg/beds/bedding, 23) and Pillowcases (/sg/accessories/pillow-cases, 6) are two independently-linked, independently-titled leaf pages reachable from different top-level nav sections (Beds vs Accessories) though Pillowcases' 6 items are a tag-filtered subset of Bedding's 23 in the site's own taxonomy id (all-beddings) - both recorded as siblings since each is a genuine distinct canonical listing URL, not a duplicate of the other.
